text: 据知情人士透露，裕信银行希望德国商业银行CEO Bettina Orlopp和董事会主席Jens Weidmann（原德国央行行长）离职。 裕信银行还反对德国政府“希望保留两个监事会席位”的主张。（路透）
text_en: According to people familiar with the matter, UniCredit wants Commerzbank CEO Bettina Orlopp and supervisory board chairman Jens Weidmann (former Bundesbank president) to leave. UniCredit also opposes the German government's position that it "wants to retain two supervisory board seats." (Reuters)
